neighbours.label: The split-off word piece 'ache' or 'ene' inside a longer word broken into pieces (moustache, mustache, toothache, stomachache, trachea, kerosene, toluene, benzene), with the word mid-sentence. Quiet on words that are one whole token (headache, ache, cache, scene, serene) and on graphene, styrene, gangrene. Also fires, more weakly, on the German word 'Sachen'.
